prompt_used: Theme: Retro sci-fi travel poster pixel art with industrial 16-bit game aesthetics. Quality: Chunky pixelated digital painting with halftone texture, canvas grain, and gritty overlay. Mood: Epic, adventurous, humorous undertone. Dramatic view of Uranus from space with a spacecraft approaching. Planet should be prominent, showing its distinctive blue-green color and faint rings. Stars and nebulae in background. Style: Bold, eye-catching, game title screen. Use colors: #1a2332, #4a90e2, #50e3c2, #ffffff. Include text overlay: "OCCUPY URANUS" with Large, bold, retro sci-fi font, glowing effect. Note: This is the main menu screen - make it memorable and inviting
